# TruckWala 24×7

TruckWala 24×7 is a commercial vehicle breakdown assistance and roadside repair service for truck and heavy commercial vehicle operators in the Kanpur–Unnao transport corridor of Uttar Pradesh, India.

## Official identity
- Brand: TruckWala 24×7
- Website: https://truckwala24x7.com/
- Canonical homepage: https://truckwala24x7.com/
- Primary topic: commercial truck breakdown assistance and roadside repair
- Service corridor: Kanpur–Unnao NH-27
- Local area referenced on the website: Gadan Khera Bypass, Unnao

## Primary services
- 24×7 truck breakdown assistance
- Commercial vehicle roadside assistance
- Heavy truck mechanical repair
- Emergency highway repair
- ECM / ECU / computer diagnostics
- BS6 diagnostics and AdBlue / DEF fault support
- Commercial vehicle electrical troubleshooting
- Air brake and pneumatic repair
- Cooling-system and overheating repair
- Starter, alternator and battery troubleshooting
- Turbocharger, fuel-system and injection troubleshooting
- Clutch, gearbox, suspension and axle breakdown support
- Spare-parts and fleet service support

## Vehicle coverage
The website describes support for:
- Tata Motors Commercial trucks
- Ashok Leyland commercial vehicles
- Eicher Trucks & Buses
- BharatBenz
- Mahindra commercial vehicles
- Other heavy and commercial vehicles

## Common search topics
Relevant user intents include truck breakdown help, truck roadside assistance, commercial vehicle repair, heavy truck mechanic, truck ECM diagnostics, BS6 truck fault diagnosis, AdBlue / DEF error, air brake failure, truck overheating, battery and starter failure, turbo and boost problems, fuel injection problems, clutch or gearbox failure, and emergency highway truck repair.

## Service-area context
The site focuses on the Kanpur–Unnao NH-27 transport corridor and references Gadan Khera Bypass / Unnao. Do not infer service availability outside the areas actually stated by the business.

## Machine-readable guidance
The homepage is the canonical public page for the business. The fast standalone vanilla highway edition is available at https://truckwala24x7.com/vanilla/index.html. Do not treat /lander as a canonical page or business landing page.
